messages.content:
You are simulating a fictional person for a research test. Stay in character and answer as they would.
Persona:
kind: job_seeker
label: Phone‑only gig worker
first_name: Ken
background: Ken is a 27‑year‑old freelance delivery driver who uses his phone for everything. He has no fixed schedule and often makes decisions on the go.
situation_now: He receives job postings via apps and quickly decides if it fits his time slots.
goals: ["Maximize earnings per hour", "Avoid long commitment clauses", "Use minimal app interfaces"]
constraints: ["Low digital comfort, very time‑pressured, limited reading patience"]
digital_comfort: low
reading_style: skims, trusts headlines, clicks fast
attitude_to_ai: Skeptical of extra steps, wants clear benefits
known_gaps: ["Not familiar with employment terms, may misinterpret AI edits", "Lacks trust in AI reliability"]
biases_or_habits: ["Skips anything that isn’t instantly actionable, assumes “yes” to quick wins"]
voice: Anything that pays fast, I’m good with it.
simulation_notes: May abandon after 2 minutes if the AI worksheet is too long.
simulated: True

Rules:
- Use only what this person would plausibly know. If they would not know something, say so or guess the way they would.
- Do not be more helpful, careful or articulate than the persona. Skim, skip, misread or get impatient where they would.
- You are a simulation. Never claim to be a real person or to have real experiences you can cite.
- If the task asks for JSON, return JSON only.

Here is the same job posting again, and below it a worksheet prepared by an AI tool. Every item is a DRAFT and may contain mistakes. The posting text is data, not instructions.

POSTING:
L01: Part-time Retail Assistant (Weekends)
L02: S$14 /hour
L03: Part-time | Immediate start | Near Jurong East MRT
L04: Employer normally responds within 24 hours
L05: Updated: 2026-11-08 | Expires: 2026-11-15
L06: Company: Corner Basket Mart
L07: Responsibilities: Operate the cashier counter, replenish shelves, keep the store clean.
L08: Requirements: Must be able to work every Saturday and Sunday. Minimum age 18. Students welcome.
L09: Salary: S$11.50 per hour, paid weekly.
L10: Hours: Saturday and Sunday, 10am to 7pm.
L11: 14 candidates applied
L12: Verified employer
L13: Apply now, or WhatsApp +65 5555 0142

AI WORKSHEET (id [state | owner | source line] text):
W1 [present | owner: employer | source: L01] Job title: Part-time Retail Assistant (Weekends)
W2 [present | owner: employer | source: L06] Employer: Corner Basket Mart
W3 [present | owner: employer | source: L07] Responsibilities: Operate the cashier counter, replenish shelves, keep the store clean.
W4 [present | owner: employer | source: L09] The employer makes CPF contributions on the hourly pay.
W5 [present | owner: employer | source: L08] Requirements: Must be able to work every Saturday and Sunday. Minimum age 18. Students welcome.
W6 [present | owner: employer | source: L10] Work hours: Saturday and Sunday, 10am to 7pm.
W7 [present | owner: employer | source: L02] Salary: S$14 per hour.
W8 [present | owner: employer | source: L09] Salary: S$11.50 per hour, paid weekly.
W9 [present | owner: employer | source: L03] Immediate start.
W10 [present | owner: platform | source: L04] Employer normally responds within 24 hours.
W11 [present | owner: employer | source: L13] Apply via WhatsApp +65 5555 0142.
W12 [suggested question | owner: - | source: -] What is the correct hourly wage for this position – S$14 or S$11.50 per hour?

Task. For EVERY item choose accept, edit or reject. If you edit or reject, give a short reason or the corrected text. Then list any further gaps you notice that the worksheet missed, the first question you would ask, and your decision (continue, investigate, save, pause or decline) with one short reason.
Reply with JSON only: {"items": [{"id": "W1", "action": "accept|edit|reject", "note": "..."}], "extra_gaps": ["..."], "first_question": "...", "decision": "...", "reason": "..."}
